question:
Identify the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Ancient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Antique.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ancient"** means something that belongs to the very distant past and no longer in existence. (प्राचीन)

 
 
• **Example: **The ancient ruins of the city attract many tourists every year.
 
 
 
• **"Antique"** refers to something that is old and often valuable. (पुरातन)
 
 
• **Example: **She collects antique furniture from different parts of the world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Antique.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unworn** (अप्रयुक्त): Something that has not been worn or used.

 
 
• **Example:** The unworn shoes were still in their original packaging.
 
 
 
• **Contemporary** (समकालीन): Belonging to or occurring in the present.
 
 
• **Example:** Contemporary art often challenges traditional boundaries.
 
 
 
• **Recent** (हाल का): Having happened or been done not long ago.
 
 
• **Example:** The recent events have left a lasting impact on the community.
